e Close all activities assigned on time and with accuracy without any follow ups

e@ Ensure all Client Communications are dealt with swiftly, and documented

| Work Experience 3
epvibo
Vibatel Solutions PvtLtd Vibatel Solutions India Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad
Group Leader July-2012 to July 2014

e Driving a team of 30+ agents to organize, design, structure and monitor customer service
calls to ensure quality standards are met

e Keeping track of activities performed as per the checklist of each individual and sending
status updates of activities performed at month-end close to the client.

e Provide leadership, coaching and support to the team, and develop plans to achieve the call
or contact center targets.

e Implement action plans for the team and individual performance improvement. Providing
the weekly process updates to higher management/ clients.

e Handle customer inquiries, complaints, and comments..

e Conducting monthly one-on-one with all my direct reports and Identifying the Areas of
Improvements and helping them to get better in that area.

e = Actively participated in Compilation & Risk stratification of all processes within Enterprise
to define High, Medium and Low Priority. Suggested re-engineering strategy, responsible
for project delivery, actively participated in Target Operating Model discussion.

e Handle additional responsibilities as and when required and ensure that the team goals
are met, and make performance assessments for each member.

| Tools :

1. Ai-Explorer: Used to work on Ai Tool to identify mismatches of agents as well as
QAs

2. Clickmagic/Clickstring: Tools which help to identify complete advertiser
account details and usually use to take action on Account if i violation

3. Bugniser: The path which helps to interact with the policy team for all
policy/grea area related concerns

4. Oscar : The Tool where initial level reviewers will get ads and related
landing pages(Websites)

5. Dashboard 2.1 & 2.2: Dashboards through which Appeal process defined and is
100% of the appeals raised are reviewed by Google FTEs



6. POLI: The Tool which helps to create PKT (Process Knowledge Test) for
agents and QAs and also use for New Policy update shared by policy team

| Personal Information:

Education Qualification | B.Sc, Bio Technology
Date of Birth | 02-08-1990

Marital Status | Married

Nationality | Indian
